versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "no-uv-filter-protection" skill.
- Guides users debating UV/skylight filters for lens protection or troubleshooting lens flare.
- Explains common misconceptions: UV filters can degrade image quality and increase lens flare risk.
- Recommends alternative protection methods (lens cap, proper cleaning, careful handling) instead of UV filters, except in harsh environments.
- Outlines when to avoid this skill (creative filter use or pure gear shopping advice).
